S11-001.title: Phase 3 activation: face pipeline migrations + Qdrant face_embeddings collection
acceptance_criteria: face_detections, face_clusters, trusted_persons tables created via Alembic 013
Qdrant face_embeddings collection with mandatory workspace_id payload index

S11-002.title: ConsentService with full audit trail
acceptance_criteria: is_consent_active / grant / revoke with Redis cache + audit_log rows
Atomic revoke + hard-delete (ART-15 §3): any hard_delete failure rolls the revoke back
Workspace isolation: consent in A never enables pipeline in B

S11-003.title: Consent API endpoints + synchronous transactional hard-delete
acceptance_criteria: CSRF required on POST/DELETE; 10/min/user rate limit
DELETE runs hard_delete synchronously inside the request transaction
Workspace isolation: hard_delete in A leaves B's face data untouched

S11-004.title: Face clustering consent UI (ConsentDialog + PhotoIntelligenceSettings)
acceptance_criteria: Scroll-to-bottom enforcement before Accept button enables
State A (disabled) / State B (enabled) cards on Photo Intelligence settings
CSRF auto-send fix in apiFetch wrapper
test_functions: ConsentDialog > enables accept button only after scroll

S11-005.title: InsightFace SCRFD detector + ArcFace recognizer singleton
acceptance_criteria: FaceModel singleton with fail-closed load() (no raise on missing deps)
PII-safe logging: whitelist enforced for every face_model.* event
buffalo_l model download script with SHA-256 verification
S11-005.coverage_notes: Tier 3 real-model test skipped unless INSIGHTFACE_MODEL_DIR + fixture present

S11-006.title: Consent-gated face detection ingestion stage with workspace isolation
acceptance_criteria: FACE_DETECTION stage inserted into photo pipeline after METADATA_EXTRACTED
process_photo_for_faces re-checks consent inside the worker
Idempotent re-runs (PG + Qdrant wipe before re-insert)
Qdrant failure rolls back in-session PG rows
Workspace isolation: two consented workspaces do not leak face rows

S11-007.title: User-initiated historical photo face backfill
acceptance_criteria: face_backfill_jobs table + worker with per-batch consent re-check
Redis cancel flag flips job state immediately

S11-008.title: Face pipeline observability — health, status, metrics, PII-safe logs
acceptance_criteria: /health face_model block extended with consent count + active backfills + last_detection_at
record_face_event / record_face_detection_latency helpers flushed into metrics table
Admin StoragePage tile visible only when consent is active somewhere

S11-009.title: Phase 3 end-to-end foundation tests + face detection ML eval baseline
acceptance_criteria: scripts/eval/eval_face_detection.py with graceful skip + JSON baseline output
S11-009.coverage_notes: ML eval baseline targets enforced by the script; real-model eval skipped in CI until dataset + models are provisioned locally

S12-001.title: HDBSCAN face clustering service
acceptance_criteria: Full re-cluster of all face_detections per workspace
Cluster identity preserved across runs via majority overlap

S12-002.title: Incremental cluster assignment
acceptance_criteria: Online per-face assignment via Qdrant neighbour search

S12-003.title: Candidate contact scoring
acceptance_criteria: Multi-signal score (co-occurrence / graph / name / temporal / size)

S12-005.title: Review Queue API
acceptance_criteria: List unconfirmed clusters sorted by top candidate score
Full detail endpoint with all member photos

S12-006.title: Merge / split / undo operations
acceptance_criteria: Merge N persons into keeper with inverse payload
Split face_detections out into a new person + cluster
Undo restores state exactly; double-undo returns 409

S12-007.title: Graph edges (Person ↔ Photo/Event/File)
acceptance_criteria: appears_in edges rebuilt per-person on create/merge/split
attended edges match contact email + fuzzy name
Admin rebuild endpoint with 1/hour/workspace rate limit

S12-008.title: Phase 3 e2e + ML eval baselines
acceptance_criteria: Eight scenario e2e test walking every Sprint 12 service
Baselines written to eval_results/ as JSON
